h10.

**`renderer.addArg` — internal/filter/render.go:842 — approx fan-in 28**

This method has the highest inbound-call count (28 callers) of any function or method declared under `internal/`. The next-highest are `filter.Schema.Field` (internal/filter/schema.go:67, ~19) and `filter.jsonArrayExpr` (internal/filter/render.go:944, ~16), so the filter renderer's `addArg` is the clear fan-in leader in that subtree.
